replace:
title: typeof issue?.title === 'string' ? issue.title : '',
    body: issue?.body,
why: The issue body joins the published snapshot, a privacy regression the field allow-list in `snapshotIssue` exists to prevent. It survived every test before issue #1025: the `issue()` fixture has no body, and an undefined key drops out of `JSON.stringify`, so a `not.toContain` over the serialised output could not fail. The privacy case plants a body, a comment count and logins in the REST shape and asserts the shaped keys are exactly the typedef's.
